digest.component_or_area: LLM provider inference and model resolution
propositions: infer_provider('gemini-2.5-pro') maps to 'google_genai', which is not registered in pydantic-ai's known providers or rebar's ProviderSession builders, causing provider construction to fail at call time.

The model-class resolution path (model_classes._resolve_target) uses the inferred provider name verbatim and composes an unresolvable qualified id like 'google_genai:gemini-2.5-pro', whereas the bare model path accidentally survives via a private translation table.

_PROVIDER_PREFIXES must map 'gemini' to 'google', which is pydantic-ai's canonical Gemini Developer API provider name and is already a member of both KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES and pydantic-ai's known providers.
Every mapped provider name in _PROVIDER_PREFIXES must be resolvable by either _pydantic_ai_known_providers() or ProviderSession._builders to prevent future regressions.
Bare gemini-* model ids must compose resolvable provider strings that pass ProviderSession.is_resolvable() validation.
The fix does not alter anthropic_model._PAI_PROVIDER_PREFIX, preserving backward compatibility for explicit model_provider configuration.
